description: This file provides an API service layer for the Planet Tracker frontend application. It includes functions to derive the backend API base URL based on environment/configuration, perform HTTP GET requests to fetch data about Near Earth Objects (NEOs), planetary positions, and health status, with robust error handling and URL management.

methods.name: API_BASE_URL
methods.description: Environment-driven configuration to determine the base URL for API requests, preferring environment variables, then window location, and finally fallback.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Utility to concatenate base URL and path safely without duplicate slashes.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to a specified path with optional query parameters, handling errors and JSON response.

methods.name: fetchNeos({ date, page, per_page } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of Near Earth Objects for a specific date, with optional pagination.

methods.name: fetchPlanets({ date } = {})
methods.description: Fetches planetary position data for a specific date.

methods.name: fetchHealth()
methods.description: Performs a health check to the backend service.

ctags.name: fetchNeos
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchNeos({ date, page, per_page } = {}) {$/
